_readme: Edit these words, then run: python tools/make_listing.py   (add --ai to also get AI-written variations)
features: Safe to spend: how much you can spend until your next payday after bills, plus a 'Can I afford it?' check
Paydays done right: weekly, every 2 weeks, the 15th & 30th, monthly, weekends, bank holidays and early-pay banks
A budget check on every purchase, with overspending alerts (optional morning email)
Bills with due dates, payment arrangements and yearly costs, so nothing sneaks up on you
Your own budget groups and %: pick a plan (50/30/20, 70/20/10...) or type your own
REAL take-home pay with built-in 2026 US tax estimates (or your own rate) and inflation built in
Savings goals, a 2026-2028 savings scorecard, savings/investing accounts, debt payoff planner and net worth
Phone view tab, a plain-English How to use guide, Google Sheets AND Excel, 3 color themes
whats_included: Google Sheets copy link (inside the PDF)
Excel .xlsx files in Sage, Midnight and Blush themes (clean or bold look)
faq: No. The free Google Sheets version works in any browser and on your phone.
No. The tax numbers are estimates to help you budget. Your pay stub is the final word.
Yes. Rename your groups (up to 6) and categories (up to 30), and set any percentages you want.
